commands.name: install
commands.description: Install dependencies exactly as locked. This repository had no aigency.json before this file — added so gates can actually run rather than reporting 'tsc: command not found' / 'vitest: command not found' / 'prettier: command not found' against an empty node_modules, which is what blocked verifying a real defect fix in this repo.

commands.name: typecheck
commands.description: tsc --noEmit — the repository's own declared typecheck script.

commands.name: test
commands.description: vitest run — the repository's own declared test script.

commands.name: lint
commands.description: prettier --check . — the repository's own declared lint script.
